query: SELECT ra AS ra_deg, dec AS dec_deg, pmra AS pm_ra, pmdec AS pm_dec, phot_g_mean_mag AS g FROM gaia_dr3.gaia_source WHERE q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 3.0492, -10.7441, 0.05) = 't' AND phot_g_mean_mag BETWEEN 12.0 AND 21.0

SELECT ra AS ra_deg, dec AS dec_deg, pmra AS pm_ra, pmdec AS pm_dec, phot_g_mean_mag AS g FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 3.0492, -10.7441, 0.05)) = 1 AND phot_g_mean_mag BETWEEN 12.0 AND 21.0
